results.headline: Beacon delivers positive topline PII/III results
results.key_quote: Positive topline result for portfolio company Beacon Therapeutics's gene therapy, laru-zova, which met its FDA-endorsed primary endpoint demonstrating statistically significant low luminesce visual acuity (LLVA) in patients
results.summary: Syncona's portfolio company Beacon Therapeutics reported positive Phase II/III pivotal VISTA trial results for laru-zova, meeting its FDA-endorsed primary endpoint with statistical significance. The high dose group achieved a 31.0% responder rate (p=0.0019) and low dose group 24.1% (p=0.0106), with patients showing ≥15-letter improvement in low light visual acuity compared to no responders in control group. This represents a key value inflection point (KVIP) - a material de-risking event with potential to drive significant NAV growth through M&A or financing opportunities. VISTA is described as the first and only pivotal trial in XLRP to achieve its FDA-endorsed primary endpoint. Beacon plans regulatory pre-submission discussions and rolling BLA submission later in 2026.
